Table quotes keep the reader's '||' and '!!' cell marks. The pages are kept in build/wiki-live/mariowiki/ in the helper's copy.

lines.line: Summary: The first world's boss, a triceratops you race in a car up a spiralling mountain in Dino Domain.

quoted: Tricky is a large triceratops and the first boss of Diddy Kong Racing
Tricky is located in Dino Domain, on his own course
Tricky and the player race up a spiraling mountain
Tricky Challenge || Car || Tricky races the player character up a spiraling mountain.

lines.line: Looks like: A big red triceratops. Yellow stripes run along his back, and his yellow eyes have red irises.

quoted: Tricky is a large triceratops
Tricky's body is red with yellow stripes on his back, and his eyes are yellow with red irises and black pupils.

lines.line: Tips: He only charges ahead, and running into him squashes you and slows you down. Weapon Balloons in red and blue sit along his course to help you against him. Boulders roll down the mountain now and then, and the second race adds more of them plus falling pillars.

quoted: there are red and blue Weapon Balloons to help the player against Tricky
The player must avoid running into Tricky, who squishes and therefore slows them down.

Beyond constantly charging forward and potentially flattening the player, he has no special behavior. Boulders occasionally travel down the mountain. In the second race, more boulders as well as falling pillars are added.

lines.line: Tips: The race opens only once you have taken all the other courses in his world. Beat him and he sets you that world's Silver Coin challenges, and finishing them opens a harder rematch where he is faster, so use the balloons to win it. His Wizpig amulet piece comes only once you beat that second race.

quoted: where the player can race him after winning every other course in the world
Tricky then challenges the player to complete every Silver Coin Challenge
In the rematch, Tricky races at a faster speed, so the player has to use Weapon Balloons to win the rematch.
awards the racer with his piece of the Wizpig amulet

lines.line: Summary: Snowflake Mountain's boss, a walrus you race in a hovercraft down an icy ski slope.

quoted: Bluey is a large, blue walrus who lives on Timber's Island
the player can challenge Bluey in his own course of Snowflake Mountain after winning every race in said world
Bluey Challenge || Hovercraft || Bluey races on a jagged, icy, downhill ski slope full of trees to act as obstacles.

lines.line: Looks like: A large blue walrus with a tuxedo piece at his neck, which the Nintendo DS remake leaves off.

quoted: Bluey is a large, blue walrus
He also wears a tuxedo piece on his neck, although not in the remake.

lines.line: Tips: The slope is jagged and lined with trees that get in your way. Just as Tricky does, he simply rushes forward, though he never squashes you.

quoted: Bluey races on a jagged, icy, downhill ski slope full of trees to act as obstacles. As with Tricky, his only behavior is stampeding forward, though he does not squish the player character.

lines.line: Tips: The rematch only comes after you finish Snowflake Mountain's Silver Coin challenges. In it Bluey is faster, and a handful of snowballs also get in your way.

quoted: Bluey gives them a new challenge of partaking in Snowflake Mountain's Silver Coin challenges
where Bluey is faster than before
In the second race, a few snowballs are added as further obstacles.

lines.line: Summary: Sherbet Island's boss, an octopus you race in a hovercraft for three laps around a small island.

quoted: Bubbler is a large red octopus and the third boss of Diddy Kong Racing
Bubbler is only allows the player to race him in his own course in Sherbet Island
Bubbler Challenge || Hovercraft || Bubbler swims three laps circling the sea around a small island, tossing explosive mines around him.

lines.line: Weak points: You can shoot him. Red Weapon Balloons give you missiles to fire at him during the race.

quoted: Bubbler can be attacked by the player shooting missiles at him from red Weapon Balloons.

lines.line: Looks like: A large red octopus. His eyes are yellow, the irises green and the pupils black.

quoted: Bubbler is a large red octopus
He has yellow eyes with green irises and black pupils.

lines.line: Tips: In the first race he scatters mines in the water around him, and hitting one trips you up.

quoted: Bubbler drops aquatic mines to trip his opponent.
tossing explosive mines around him

lines.line: Tips: In the rematch he is faster and trades the mines for huge bubbles that catch you and hold you for a while.

quoted: The second race is more challenging, since Bubbler now moves faster and drops bubbles that temporarily encapsulate the player.
In the second race, he instead launches giant bubbles that can trap the player character.

lines.line: Summary: Dragon Forest's boss, a dragon you race in a plane for three laps through caves and fields.

quoted: Smokey is a boss in Diddy Kong Racing
the player can race Smokey at his own course in Dragon Forest
In the boss race, the player has to race Smokey while in a plane.
Smokey runs and flies three laps through a series of caves and fields.

lines.line: Looks like: An orange dragon whose belly, face and feet are yellow. His eyes are green, so he is the one boss that lacks yellow eyes.

quoted: His body is colored orange with a yellow belly, face, and feet, and his eyes are green (making him the only boss in the game without yellow eyes).

lines.line: Tips: He spits clouds of hot ash and drops puffs of fire behind him, and the fire can slow you down. In the rematch he flies faster and drops more of it.

quoted: Smokey drops behind puffs of fire that can slow the player.
In his second race, Smokey flies faster than before and drops behind more fireballs.
He attacks by spitting clouds of hot ash to be ran into.

lines.line: Tips: Smokey Castle, the challenge level with his name, is not where you meet him, because he does not appear there.

quoted: Smokey has a challenge level named after him, Smokey Castle, but he does not appear here.

sections.name: Taj's three vehicle races (Car, Hovercraft, Plane)

lines.line: Summary: In Adventure Mode, Taj shows up after you have gathered enough Golden Balloons and calls you out to race him in a set vehicle. He rides a flying carpet, and beating him gives you one more Golden Balloon.

quoted: After the player collects enough Golden Balloons in Adventure Mode, Taj will appear and challenge the player to a race in a specific vehicle.
The player has to race Taj, who rides a flying carpet.
After Taj is beaten, he will reward the player with another Golden Balloon.

lines.line: Weak points: He moves slowly in the Car Challenge, so that race is the easy one to win.

quoted: Car Challenge is a relatively easy race done in a car.
This should be very easy for the player because of Taj's slow movement.

lines.line: Looks like: A blue elephant who is also a genie and rides a magic red carpet.

quoted: Taj is a blue elephant and a genie who lives on Timber's Island.
Taj uses a magic red carpet for transportation as well as in his vehicle races

lines.line: Tips: The Hovercraft race is a little harder than the Car race, and the Plane race is rated the hardest of his three. The route is marked by red flags bearing the Nintendo 64 logo. Follow them, because straying a long way from the track disqualifies you.

quoted: Hovercraft Challenge is the second of Taj's races and is somewhat more difficult than the Car Challenge.
Plane Challenge is considered to be the hardest of Taj's three races and a plane is used in it.
The racetrack is marked with red flags showing the Nintendo 64 logo and the player has to follow them. If they leave the set track by too far a margin, they will be disqualified.

lines.line: Tips: Once a race is unlocked you can run it again whenever you like, but each one gives only a single Golden Balloon.

quoted: each of them can be repeated at any time after they have been unlocked (the player will only obtain one Golden Balloon per challenge however).

lines.line: Summary: In Tracks mode, Time Trial has you race T.T.'s best times. It is optional for the adventure, but beating him on every course is what makes T.T. playable.

quoted: Time Trial mode is also accessed here, where the player needs to race to beat T.T.'s best times. This is optional in the main game, but it is required to unlock T.T. himself.
if they can beat T.T. in all races, he will become playable

lines.line: Looks like: T.T. is an animated stopwatch. His shell is red on the outside with a yellow case inside, a blue button sits on top of his head, and his black arms and legs end in white gloves and shoes.

quoted: T.T. is an animated stopwatch
T.T. has a pair of two black arms and legs, with a white glove on each hand and a white shoe on each foot.
There is a blue button on his head, and T.T.'s outer shell is red, while his inner case is yellow.

lines.line: Tips: Each course has two times, an unlock time that brings out T.T.'s ghost and then a lower ghost time to beat. For example, Ancient Lake is 1:07.00 then 1:01.28, Fossil Canyon 1:37.00 then 1:30.16, Jungle Falls 1:08.00 then 1:02.50 and Hot Top Volcano 1:35.00 then 1:30.71.

quoted: The player must get good enough times around tracks in Time Trials mode to unlock T.T.'s ghost for each course, and then beat each.
Course !! Unlock time !! Ghost time

lines.line: Summary: Eight coins to find on each course. Collect all eight and win the race to earn a Golden Balloon.

quoted: Every course has a Silver Coin Challenge, where the objective is to collect eight Silver Coins and win in first place.
Collecting every one in a Silver Coin Challenge rewards a Golden Balloon.
Eight Silver Coins appear in each standard race course for their Coin Challenges.

lines.line: Uses: Taj hands over the Golden Balloon when you finish a challenge. Each world's challenges unlock only once you have won the race against that world's boss, and every course also asks for a certain number of Golden Balloons before its challenge can be played.

quoted: When the player's racer completes a Silver Coin Challenge, Taj awards them with a Golden Balloon.

The player can only participate in a world's Silver Coin Challenges after winning against the world boss in a race, and every race course has their own minimum requirement of Golden Balloons needed to play the challenges.

lines.line: Looks like: In the original game each coin has a colourful N64 icon on its sides.

quoted: the Silver Coins have a colorful N64 icon designed on the sides

lines.line: Tips: Plenty of the coins are concealed well or lie outside the track.

quoted: Many of them are well hidden or located off-track.

lines.line: Tips: Clearing the Silver Coin Challenge on all four courses of a world sets up the rematch with that world's boss. Adventure Two, a harder take on Adventure Mode, shifts the coins to other spots, and many are awkward to get to.

quoted: Completing the Silver Coin Challenge in all four courses of Dino Domain, Snowflake Mountain, Sherbet Island and Dragon Forest engages the player in a rematch against the world's boss
Adventure Two is played the same as the standard Adventure Mode, but harder.
the locations of the silver coins are different, often in hard to reach places

lines.line: Summary: The red Weapon Balloon gives missiles, and they get stronger the more red balloons you collect in a row. Every Weapon Balloon colour works this way, up to three levels.

quoted: Red Balloon Missiles
collecting multiple of the same color in sequence improves the item's effects by up to a total of three levels

lines.line: Uses: One red balloon gives a missile that fires straight ahead, two give a homing missile and three give a volley of ten.

quoted: Missiles || One forward-firing missile || One homing missile || One 10x multi-shot missile
A missile
A homing missile
Ten missiles

lines.line: Looks like: Red, with yellow stars printed on it; the blue and green balloons carry yellow stars as well.

quoted: Most kinds of Weapon Balloons have printed stars on them.
While the red, blue and green balloons have yellow stars on them

lines.line: Tips: Being hit by a missile of any of the three levels makes you lose some bananas.

quoted: If players get hit (by a level 1-3 red balloon or level 2-3 green balloon), they lose some bananas.

lines.line: Summary: The blue Weapon Balloon gives a speed boost, in up to three levels.

quoted: Blue Balloon Speed boosts
collecting multiple of the same color in sequence improves the item's effects by up to a total of three levels

lines.line: Uses: One blue balloon gives a small boost, two give a larger one and three give the biggest. With a single balloon, letting go of the accelerator button while you use it gives a bigger boost.

quoted: A small speed boost. As with the Zippers, releasing the accelerator button gives a larger boost.
A larger speed boost
The most significant speed boost

lines.line: Tips: In battle courses an item can only be upgraded once.

quoted: Battle stages allow only up to the first upgrade.

lines.line: Tips: ROCKETFUEL is a cheat (a magic code, reached from the options menu) that turns every balloon blue.

quoted: Magic Codes are game cheats, always accessible in the options menu.
ROCKETFUEL || All balloons are blue

lines.line: Summary: The yellow Weapon Balloon gives a shield, in up to three levels.

quoted: Yellow Balloon Shield
collecting multiple of the same color in sequence improves the item's effects by up to a total of three levels

lines.line: Uses: The shield blocks hits, and any racer you bump into while it is up spins out. One balloon makes it short, two make it longer and three make it last the longest.

quoted: A short-lasting shield which protects against hits. If the players run into opponents, the opponents spin out.
A longer-lasting shield which protects against hits. If the players run into opponents, the opponents spin out.
A long-lasting shield. If the players run into opponents, the opponents spin out.

lines.line: Looks like: A yellow balloon with purple stars printed on it.

quoted: the yellow balloon has purple stars on it

lines.line: Tips: BODYARMOR is a cheat (a magic code, reached from the options menu) that turns every balloon yellow.

quoted: Magic Codes are game cheats, always accessible in the options menu.
BODYARMOR || All balloons are yellow

sections.name: Green Weapon Balloon (oil, mines and bubbles)

lines.line: Summary: The green Weapon Balloon gives something you drop, in up to three levels.

quoted: Green Balloon Dropper
collecting multiple of the same color in sequence improves the item's effects by up to a total of three levels

lines.line: Uses: One green balloon gives an oil slick, or a gas cloud if you are in a plane. Two give a land mine, which floats for planes, and three give a bubble that snares whoever rides into it, floats them upward until it pops, and costs them a good deal of time.

quoted: Dropper || An oil slick or gas cloud || A land mine or floating mine || A snare bubble which delays enemies for a significant time
An oil spill (Cars and Hovercrafts) Gas cloud (Planes)
A land mine (Cars and Hovercrafts) Floating land mine (Planes)
A bubble that traps a racer that rides into it, floats upward, and pops

lines.line: Tips: Being hit by the second or third green item, the mine or the bubble, makes you lose some bananas.

quoted: If players get hit (by a level 1-3 red balloon or level 2-3 green balloon), they lose some bananas.

lines.line: Tips: TOXICOFFENDER is a cheat (a magic code, reached from the options menu) that turns every balloon green.

quoted: Magic Codes are game cheats, always accessible in the options menu.
TOXICOFFENDER || All balloons are green

lines.line: Summary: The rainbow Weapon Balloon gives a magnet, in up to three levels.

quoted: Rainbow Balloon Special
collecting multiple of the same color in sequence improves the item's effects by up to a total of three levels

lines.line: Uses: A single rainbow balloon gives a weak magnet that tugs you toward a racer ahead, if one is close enough. Two make the pull stronger and the range longer, and three give a powerful magnet that drags opponents back to you.

quoted: Special || A weak pull toward the racer in front of the player, if in range || A magnet with a stronger pull and longer range || A powerful magnet that pulls opponents towards the player

lines.line: Tips: The weak magnet is yellow and the stronger one is red.

quoted: A weak, yellow magnet that pulls the user towards a nearby racer
A stronger, red magnet

lines.line: Tips: OPPOSITESATTRACT is a cheat (a magic code, reached from the options menu) that turns every balloon rainbow.

quoted: Magic Codes are game cheats, always accessible in the options menu.
OPPOSITESATTRACT || All balloons are rainbows

lines.line: Summary: Four keys, one hidden on a course in each of the first four worlds, each opening the door to that world's challenge level.

quoted: The game features four keys. One is hidden in a race course of each world. Their purpose is to unlock the door to the Challenge level in the corresponding world's hub
Future Fun Land is the only world in the game that does not have a challenge level.

lines.line: Uses: The keys are in Ancient Lake in Dino Domain, Snowball Valley in Snowflake Mountain, Crescent Island in Sherbet Island and Boulder Canyon in Dragon Forest. A challenge level is an arena where you play against computer racers or other players, and winning one in Adventure Mode earns a piece of the T.T. amulet.

quoted: A key appears in Ancient Lake of the Dino Domain, Snowball Valley of Snowflake Mountain, Crescent Island of Sherbet Island, and, lastly, Boulder Canyon of Dragon Forest.
where the racer can compete against CPUs or other players
in Adventure Mode, if they are won in, pieces of the T.T. amulet are rewarded

lines.line: Tips: Fire Mountain is a plane level where you haul eggs out of the lava pit at the centre back to your nest and wait for them to hatch. Opponents can pinch your eggs or hit you with missiles, and whoever hatches three first wins. Smokey Castle is a car level where you collect bananas and put them in the treasure chests at the middle of the arena, and the first racer to get ten in wins.

quoted: The objective of this challenge level is to obtain eggs from the central lava pit, carry them to their nest, and wait for the eggs to hatch. Other players may attempt to sabotage the effort by stealing eggs or using missiles against them. The first player who hatches three eggs wins.
The first racer who puts ten bananas in their treasure chest wins.
collect bananas and store them in large treasure chests in the central area
Fire Mountain || Plane
Smokey Castle || Car

lines.line: Tips: Icicle Pyramid (a car level) and Darkwater Beach (a hovercraft level) are fights with weapons, and your banana count is your health. Run out and you are out, and the last player left wins.

quoted: The objective of this challenge level is to eliminate foes by using weapons against them. Bananas represent a drivers' health and if they run out, they are eliminated. The last player standing wins the challenge.
Icicle Pyramid || Car
Darkwater Beach || Hovercraft

lines.line: Summary: Each world's Trophy Race strings its four tracks together and scores points, and a high enough finish wins a trophy.

quoted: Trophies can be gained by placing high enough in a world's Trophy Race, racing through the world's four tracks back-to-back to accumulate the most points.

lines.line: Uses: Finishing first gives you the Wizpig trophy in gold, second the Taj trophy in silver, and third the T.T. trophy in bronze. Reaching Future Fun Land takes four trophies.

quoted: First place earns a golden Wizpig trophy, second place earns a silver Taj trophy, and third place earns a bronze T.T. trophy. Four trophies are needed to access Future Fun Land.

lines.line: Tips: A world's Trophy Race becomes available once you have beaten that world's boss for the second time. The computer racers in it are tougher than in a single race.

quoted: In addition, Trophy Races are unlocked for each world after the second boss race has been cleared.
Trophy Races feature harder AI racers than the single races.

lines.line: Tips: Trophy Races can also be played from Tracks mode, but only in the standard vehicle of each track.

quoted: Trophy Races and Challenge levels are also accessible through Tracks mode; however, players always use each track's default vehicle
